Ben —

Also add me to any waitlist for a demo slot — if something opens earlier we'd be interested.

Appreciate it — Alicia

alicia@novatech.com

Marissa / Rishi —

Heads-up: Novatech (NB-2028-1143) just told us they need to pause demo scheduling because engineering resources are pulled to a product launch and there's a hiring freeze. They asked for an exec summary and to revisit in Q4.

Options I'm considering:
- Put them on the demo waitlist and set a quarterly check-in (Oct 1)
- Offer a small courtesy credit + reserved 1-week trial when they re-open (we've done this before for similar accounts)
- Change HubSpot stage to 'nurture' and add them to the Q4 re-engagement cadence

Ben —

Thanks for flagging. This is a pretty standard deprioritization cadence — product launches tend to do this. Approve the nurture approach. Specifics:

- Offer a reserved trial credit (1-week reserved compute credit) — approved. Ask Revenue Ops to create a one-time trial code tied to NB-2028-1143.
- Move deal to 'nurture' in HubSpot and set task for Ben to check in Oct 2nd and Dec 1st.
- Send Alicia the exec summary and the references, but do not push for dates. Keep outreach value-led (cost sketch + reference story).
- If they request procurement language, coordinate with Laura (cc'd) — Laura, please prepare the minimal SOW language we use for courtesy trials.

I'll also authorize a small goodwill credit if procurement pushes back during re-engagement.

Marissa
